title_en: Meet the team behind the lab
objective: The viewer sees that the lab is made of people and wants to know who they are.
hero_en: Message: the lab is made of people. Wide documentary photograph of the lab team standing in a single row inside the lab, relaxed, facing camera with natural expressions, in the work clothing of the source clip; bench lines softly behind; teal-green sky grade from the window light, warm skin, no readable label on any container. Horizon line at about three fifths of the tile height, headline above, credit line below.
compliance_note: Team portrait only; no description of lab activity, no figures, no assurance wording.
sub_en: The people who are here every morning
caption_ar:
خلف كل باب في مدينة سدير فريقٌ يعمل بهدوء.
نبدأ شهرنا بزملائنا في المختبر: وجوهٌ تحضر كل صباح.
ما الذي تودّون معرفته عنهم؟ اكتبوا لنا في التعليقات.
caption_en:
Behind every door in Sudair City there is a team that works quietly.
We begin the month with our colleagues in the lab: faces that show up every morning.
What would you like to know about them? Tell us in the comments.
